subject: Expansion to additional silos — integration schedule & amendment approach
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@marigold.health>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marigold Procurement <procurement@marigold.health>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion: 3 new teams + keys — need timeline and amendment

Hi Rohan,

Quick note from our product org: we plan to enable three additional internal teams (Search, Clinical QA, and ChatOps) on Redwood over the next two quarters. Rough asks:
- ~12 new API keys (scoped per team/project)
- A short rollout plan (canary + bulk activation)
- Any term/commitment implications if we add this footprint now (we're approaching renewal window)

Attached is our current usage extract for July–Aug so you can see token patterns. Can you send a recommended approach and rough pricing delta? Procurement will want an amendment outline they can pass to legal/finance.

Thanks — happy to jump on 30 minutes this week.

Best,
Elena Park
Product Manager — Platform
Marigold Health
Attachment: current_usage_report.csv (CSV)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@marigold.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: 3 new teams + keys — need timeline and amendment

Hi Elena — thanks for the usage snapshot, that helps. High-level thoughts:

1) Rollout approach
- Week 0–2: Provision 2 canary keys (one for Search, one for ChatOps) with throttles and KV-cache prewarm.
- Week 3–6: Add remaining team keys in two waves; run perf checks and cost telemetry.
- Month 2–3: Bulk activation and handover to your SREs with playbook.

2) Term / commit implications
- If you want a price concession for the incremental capacity, we can attach a 6‑month committed addendum to your renewal (amendment DL-7831-A) that reduces per-token unit price when monthly committed usage is met.
- Alternatively, purely on-demand keys are supported but will be priced at list.

3) Inputs we need from you
- List of projects + expected daily token volumes per project
- Owners for each key (email)
- Any regulatory constraints (PHI handling) per team

I'll loop Marissa on pricing options and Ben for capacity planning. Proposed meeting: Fri 9/3 3pm PT or Mon 9/6 9am PT. Which works?

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@marigold.health>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: 3 new teams + keys — need timeline and amendment

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up. Sharing two commercial options based on Rohan's commit suggestion:

Option A — Staged add-on (recommended)
- Commit: Additional 6‑month commit tied to these 3 teams (month-by-month true-up)
- Pricing: 12% discount on incremental token tiers once committed threshold is reached
- Activation: staged as Rohan outlined

Option B — On-demand (no amend)
- No change to current term; pay list for the extra keys

Numbers (ballpark, monthly):
- Expected incremental tokens: 9M–14M
- Option A est. delta: $12k–$18k / month after discount
- Option B est. delta: $15k–$22k / month

I've attached a draft amendment quote and a capacity plan to show how we'd stagger keys and headroom. If you want we can prepare a DocuSign amendment (DL-7831-A) to get procurement moving.

Attachments: RA-quote-Marigold-DL7831.pdf (PDF); capacity_plan.xlsx (XLSX)

If procurement needs a PO template or SOC2 evidence, ping procurement@redwood.com and we'll push the pack.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena@marigold.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marigold Procurement <procurement@marigold.health>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: 3 new teams + keys — need timeline and amendment

Thanks everyone. Procurement prefers Option A but will need:
- SOC 2 attestation and data handling addendum (for Clinical QA)
- A PO and amended SOW that shows effective dates and the 6‑month commit start date
- Clarification on SLA/latency for the canary window — if we hit an outage during canary, what fallback is supported?

Tentative timelines from our side: procurement sign-off by 9/17, kickoff 9/27 if amendment signed.

I've attached our internal PO template to speed the legal docs.

Best,
Elena
Attachment: PO_template.docx (DOCX)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@marigold.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: 3 new teams + keys — need timeline and amendment

Elena — great, Option A it is. Quick next steps and owners:

1) Marissa to send DocuSign amendment (DL-7831-A) + quote (target: 9/9) — Marissa
2) Ben to finalize capacity plan and reserve burst pool for canary (target: 9/10) — Ben
3) Elena and procurement to review PO_template and confirm sign-off date (target: 9/17) — Elena / Procurement
4) Kickoff & canary activation (Search + ChatOps keys) — 9/27
5) Bulk activation wave 1 — 10/11; wave 2 — 10/25

SLA during canary: we will treat canary keys as production-grade for the duration, but we will include a 1‑week monitored ramp and a backstop route that fails over to your previous model endpoint in case of critical latency regressions. We'll include this language in the amendment.

I will attach the DocuSign link as soon as Marissa prepares the amendment. If anyone wants the kickoff agenda now I can send a short playbook (API key naming convention, key rotation windows, and escalation contacts).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
